items.headline: What is a context window?
items.hook: Why does an AI seem to forget the start of a long chat? The context window.
points: A context window is the amount of text, counted in tokens, that a model can take into account at once.
If a conversation or document is longer than the window, the model cannot use all of it in one request.
items.takeaway: For long documents, check the model's window, or split the job into parts.
items.ask: What is the longest document you have asked an AI to read?
